question: Compared to a soft sound, a louder sound wave of the same frequency is characterised by __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Larger Amplitude**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Amplitude** is directly related to the loudness of a sound. A louder sound corresponds to a sound wave with a **larger amplitude**. Hence, the correct answer is **Larger Amplitude**.
 
• The **frequency** of the sound wave determines its pitch and does not change in this scenario, as the question specifies that both sounds have the same frequency.
 
• The **wavelength** of a sound wave is inversely proportional to its frequency, but since the frequency is constant in this case, the wavelength remains unchanged.
 
• The **speed of sound** depends on the medium through which the sound travels and is not affected by the loudness or amplitude of the sound.
